options.name: label
options.description: Label and accessible name of the text field.

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Visually hide the label; it remains the accessible name.

options.name: value
options.description: Initial text; also the value restored by reset().

options.name: name
options.description: Form field name.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Supplementary hint; never replaces the label.

options.name: description
options.description: Help text referenced by aria-describedby.

options.name: required
options.description: Empty text (without attachments) is invalid.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Disables the field and its buttons.

options.name: status
options.description: Reply state: sending locks the field and shows a spinner; streaming turns Send into Stop.

options.name: rows
options.description: Visible rows when empty (integer 1..40).

options.name: maxRows
options.description: The field grows up to this many rows, then scrolls (integer >= rows).

options.name: maxLength
options.description: Limit in counter units (characters, or the units of count); validated, not truncated.

options.name: showCounter
options.description: Show the counter; requires maxLength.

options.name: count
options.description: Counter hook, for example a tokenizer; returns the size of the text in its own units.

options.name: counterUnit
options.description: Unit in the counter text; default characters, or tokens when count is set.

options.name: attachments
options.description: Show the attach button and accept pasted or dropped files.

options.name: accept
options.description: Accepted MIME types (image/*) or extensions (.pdf); empty accepts any.

options.name: maxFiles
options.description: Most files attached at once (integer 1..100).

options.name: maxFileSize
options.description: Largest file in bytes, or null for no limit.

options.name: triggers
options.description: Suggestions popups for trigger characters: { char, suggest(query) } (slash commands, mentions).

options.name: showHint
options.description: Show the keyboard hint (how to send and add a line) under the field.

options.name: icons
options.description: Icon slot overrides (send, stop, attach, remove, file, error).

options.name: submitKey
options.description: Enter sends (Shift+Enter adds a line), or Ctrl/Cmd+Enter sends (Enter adds a line).

options.name: validationTiming
options.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

options.name: locale
options.description: Message and number-formatting locale.

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer host; its children are owned by the component.

properties.name: validity
properties.description: { valid, error, message }; computed on every change.

properties.name: dirty
properties.description: Text differs from the initial value, or files are attached.

properties.name: touched
properties.description: Focus has left the control at least once.

properties.name: suggestionsOpen
properties.description: Whether the suggestions popup is open.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Send like the Send button: emits the cancelable aui-send and clears the field unless prevented; false when nothing was sent.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Programmatic text (no events); clears an external custom error.

methods.name: setAttachments
methods.description: Replace the attached files (no events; limits are not applied).

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Add files as if the user picked them: limits apply, aui-attachment-change is emitted; returns the refused files.

methods.name: openFilePicker
methods.description: Open the file chooser (attachments must be enabled).

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clear the text and the attachments (no events).

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error; cleared when the user edits.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial text, remove attachments, and clear dirty/touched/submitted state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, listeners, registration, and subscriptions.

events.name: aui-input
events.description: User edited the text: { value, validity }.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: User committed the text (native change, on blur).

events.name: aui-send
events.description: User sent: { text, attachments }; prevent it to keep the text and files in the field.

events.name: aui-stop
events.description: User pressed Stop while status is streaming.

events.name: aui-attachment-change
events.description: Files were attached or removed by the user: { attachments, rejected }.

events.name: aui-suggestion-select
events.description: A suggestion was inserted: { trigger, suggestion }.

cssClasses.name: aui-prompt-input__box
cssClasses.description: The bordered box around chips, field, and toolbar (shows focus).

cssClasses.name: aui-prompt-input__toolbar | __attach | __send | __spacer
cssClasses.description: Toolbar with the attach button, counter, and Send/Stop.
